methodProtocolRows.scientificReasons: Real three identified precut specimens, learner mount and microscope control, comparable scale labelled sketches. Conducting moss cells not falsely denied; differences do not imply living direct ancestry. Required observations/device record cannot be replaced by fabricated sample dataset.

Predefined random sampling ten same-species leaves at each of two sites with dimensions, feeding traces, uncertainty and rawdata. Within-species variation distinct from species diversity; no genes, environmental cause or selection proven merely by leaf metrics. No predicted result quota.

Actually produce clay negative mould and contrasting cast, compare shape/original material, trace/body distinction; limits geological time/compaction/mineral replacement retained.713e cannot alone certify construction;82ac actual conduct can contribute only with a reviewed route.

Equal size40+40 tokens, two backgrounds,20seconds, randomized distribution, alternating≥3trials, observed counts/uncertainty and contrary data retained. Paper survivor bias models differential survival, not generations; inheritance/reproduction explicitly required for evolutionary frequency change. Human collection remains unperformed.

Two actual parameter outputs40replicates population200 seed7300 and100 seed7301,5generations, neutral and reversed relative weights. Code implements asexual weighted offspring sampling with replacement, not literal measured survival nor diploid genetics. Reported final neutral means0.523625/0.486, brown favoured0.999/0.99875, light favoured0.001/0.00125. Random finite-size drift visible; no mutation/recombination/generative organism evidence or ethical breeding decision claimed.
